description: He wears a dark olive-green finely woven knee-length noble tunic over a cream linen shirt, with ornate gold-tan knotwork at the neckline, cuffs and hem. A broad decorated brown leather belt has a large round buckle and long patterned hanging end. A heavy green-brown plaid cloak with worked knotwork borders and fringed edges hangs from a round ornate shoulder brooch. Brown gathered trousers and tall dark brown leather boots complete the outfit. No headgear, armor or weapons are visible.
